title: Barramundi Tagine with Egyptian Spices
description: A German-inspired take on the traditional Moroccan dish, featuring pan-seared barramundi and a flavorful tagine spice blend.

ingredients.name: Tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the barramundi fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the fish to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tbsp of oil and the tagine spice blend.
Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Add the sliced almonds and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Serve the fish over fluffy rice, garnished with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon.
Optional: sprinkle with Egyptian cinnamon for added flavor.
